_doc: Colorado Blvd's light poles read by eye on the DRAPP 2022 3-inch orthophoto crop (colorado_ortho_g10.py fetch / chips / crop), every pole-like shadow over the crop (lap s -20..435, u -50..+50). Pixels are crop pixels (column: 0.25 ft east; row: 0.5 ft south, every 2nd row of the tiles). The sun stood in the south-east (morning): every shadow runs north-west from its base. A pole is READ only when a head or arm and its shadow line agree on its base: base_px = where the pole's shadow starts and the pole's own image (a short dark stroke leaning east: the photo's relief displacement) starts; shadow_tip_px = the pole shadow's far end (the arm junction where an arm shadow branches); head_shadow_px = the arm shadow's end (the luminaire); head_image_px where the arm and head are seen themselves. Each pick was read at 2-3x zoom; +-2 px.
